channel.title: International Business Times India - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from International Business Times India (ibtimes.co.in)

item.title: Congress to Bring Rahul Gandhi, Kharge to Kashmir Amid Row Over India–US Trade Deal
item.description: Amid mounting political and farmer backlash over the proposed India–US trade deal, the Congress has announced that Leader of Opposition Rahul Gandhi and party president Mallikarjun Kharge will visit the Kashmir Valley to interact with fruit growers.

item.title: Toxic: Yash lifts Kiara Advani in his arms, smokes cigar, shirtless in first poster of Tabaahi
item.description: Yash appears shirtless, smoking a cigar, as he lifts Kiara Advani in the first poster of Tabaahi from Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-Ups. The film, starring Yash, Kiara, Nayanthara, and others, is directed by Geetu Mohandas and releases on 19 March 2026. The single Tabaahi will drop on March 2.

item.title: History beckons for J&K in Ranji final; Omar heads to Hubli to cheer team
item.description: Jammu and Kashmir moved within touching distance of their maiden Ranji Trophy title after taking a commanding 477-run overall lead against Karnataka in the 2025–26 final at Hubli.

item.title: BSE Sensex, NIFTY 50 fall 1.5% as global tensions dampen market mood
item.description: For the week, both the Sensex and the Nifty fell around 1.5 per cent. Broader markets also remained under pressure, with the Nifty Midcap 100 and Smallcap 100 indices declining more than 1 per cent each.

item.title: Chuck Schumer leads Democrats in demanding $130 billion tariff refund from Donald Trump administration
item.description: Top Senate Democrats, led by Chuck Schumer, have demanded that the Donald Trump administration return more than $130 billion in tariffs after the Supreme Court of the United States ruled 6–3 that the President exceeded his authority in imposing them under the International Emergency Economic Powers Act.

item.title: 'Power is temporary, character is permanent': Jeet Adani spotlights inclusion at GreenX Talks
item.description: Jeet Adani, Director of Adani Airport Holdings Limited, said at the fifth edition of GreenX Talks in Ahmedabad that the Adani Group measures growth through inclusion rather than scale. Calling the platform a celebration of dignity, possibility and human excellence.

item.title: 'Deep respect for safety': Sam Altman on OpenAI's classified Pentagon deployment
item.description: The move comes amid reported disagreements between the Pentagon and Anthropic over limits on military applications of AI. OpenAI said it will implement technical safeguards, deploy field engineers, and ensure the models operate only on secure cloud networks, while maintaining that its safety commitments remain intact.

item.title: 'Broken Promises': Democrats blame Donald Trump tariffs for farm distress and food inflation
item.description: US Senate Democrats have accused Donald Trump of worsening a farm and food affordability crisis through his tariffs, saying the trade war with China has cut US soybean exports and left farmers with surplus crops and financial strain.

item.title: At least 19 killed in border clashes; United Nations urges Afghanistan-Pakistan de-escalation
item.description: Antonio Guterres has called for an immediate ceasefire between Afghanistan and Pakistan amid escalating border clashes. His spokesperson Stephane Dujarric said the UN chief is deeply concerned about civilian casualties and urged both sides to pursue diplomacy and uphold international humanitarian law.

item.title: Cyber Fraudsters Impersonate Migna Sherpa Within 48 Hours of Him Taking Charge as DC of J&K's Udhampur
item.description: Within just 48 hours of assuming office as Deputy Commissioner of Udhampur, IAS officer Migna Sherpa became the target of cyber fraudsters who circulated fake messages using his photograph on social media and WhatsApp. The district administration swiftly issued a public advisory warning residents against responding to or forwarding suspicious messages claiming to be from the DC.
